partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-001: One mixer stage per audio, MIDI and return track and the main track; source, devices in order, mixer stage; one main and one send output per return; send k and the k-th SendPreBool belong to the k-th return in list order; tracks output to the main track; render output is the main track's main output
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-002: Main output M_main x and send outputs M_k x per sample; no other gain between device chain and mixer stage; return and main inputs are sums
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-003: Crossfade assignment None and no automation: volume gain equals the stored gain from 0.0003162277571 to 1.99526238, zero at or below 0.0003199999919; main track the same
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-004: Main matrix is the main gate times the pan-law matrix; the pan law; split amount is the stored PanMode code and ramps over the fade length
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-005: Send matrix g e a (q P + (1 - q) I) for a track outside any group; pre and post consequences; q from SendPreBool; a send at its stored minimum contributes nothing; send output to the k-th return
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-006: Destination inputs are per-sample sums; send sums in binary64 then binary32; main outputs binary32; return mixer shapes its output; main has no sends and its main output is the render output
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-007: With no track soloed, track switch off sets both gates to 0, on sets them to 1; changes ramp over the fade length
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-008: Main and send gates for each solo category and the track switch; no soloed track when no mixer stores SoloSink true; category assignment not released
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-009: Per-sample gains; ramp rules (linear, immediate below 1e-12 per sample, binary32 step); main entries move from the first sample, send entries one sample later; pan-law entries ramp to the value at the end of the shortest input ramp; values below 1e-12 count as 0
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-010: Fade length 75 samples at every sample rate for the gates, the post amount and the split amount; unchanged values give no ramp after the start
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-011: Render convention: a render starts from the settled state of the opened set (project convention, not original behavior)
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-013: Playback value of an envelope as a computation: point list with the first time of a Float envelope at -10,000,000 beats, 16-piece curved segments, lookup at envelope time with the later of two equal times, segment value in samples under the default automation settings, hold, Bool and Enum without interpolation at or after the first event; envelope time, the samples at which point times take effect, drive, each parameter's automation settings and units not released
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-MIX-GRAPH-014: Ramp length of an automated value under the default automation settings: max(200, min(65536, trunc(q / |slope|))) while playing, none for a flat segment or a stopped transport; last ramp shortened, new segment at each point; q is an input (one thousandth of the driven parameter's range); which parameters use the default settings, and their q, not released; only q / |slope| below 2^31

fixture_origin: independently authored minimal Live Set documents built for this release on the project's minimal-set rules, and two generated 16-bit test signals; no shipped file content, audio or program code

reviewers: separate review agent (Claude Opus 5.5) in a coordinator-launched handoff-review context; not the author; will not implement
findings: RMG-01 medium: REQ-013's Float value and REQ-014 hold only for the default automation settings; two stated assumptions bound mixer parameters and pan's step to them; narrowed to the defined default settings, which parameters use them and their step not released, assumptions removed; no case changed

RMG-02 low: the render-case envelope exclusion contradicted the main track's one-event tempo and time-signature envelopes in every fixture; those two exempted when equal to the stored value; no case changed

RMG-03 low: REQ-013's sample-timing sentence depends on the unreleased song-position mapping and the first-time replacement was shown for Float envelopes only; moved to not released and scoped; no case changed
RMG-04 info: ramp-length rule fails for q/|s| of 2^31 or more (reviewer's static check); exclusion upheld
RMG-05 info: out-of-range stored volumes and the draft internal-predicate case stay out; one sentence reworded
RMG-06 info: no expectation depends on an open item; every render case is labeled composed spec conformance and was recomposed and rendered by the reviewer
RMG-07 info: all 11 fixtures pass the structural checker and the reviewer's shape check; signals generated
RMG-08 editorial: category labels, pan-law provenance and send-exclusion wording
RMG-09 editorial: payload status set to reviewed release; review record added
RMG-10 info: evidence identity re-hashed; all match
review.disposition: Approved with listed narrowing (RMG-01 to RMG-03), only for the explicit partial clauses; 28 cases released unchanged; computation expectations extracted execution or static-derived as labeled; render expectations composed spec conformance, not measured compatibility; reference and candidate execution not-run; restricted implementation workspace required
